_comment: Ratchet floor for monitor/test/approach-taxonomy-coverage.test.mjs. `undeclared`: checks the fleet runs that approach-taxonomy.json does not describe. `orphans`: approaches naming a check no manifest declares — usually a lane whose manifest change is unlanded, so it is banked rather than red.
